mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the CPIAUCSL inflation index predicts negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to investor anticipation of rate hikes.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by 0.5% over the prior 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-negative in >70% of CPIAUCSL up moves, or inflation decelerates by >1% in the following quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS labor claims coincides with a positive S&P 500 60-day forward return as market interprets stronger labor demand.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns underperform a 5% confidence interval based on historical PAYEMS growth in strong labor months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO manufacturing index suggests supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are non-negative in >50% of INDPRO declines, or INDPRO recovers by >10% in the next two months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both HOUST retail sales and GDPC1 personal consumption indicates robust demand, predicting a positive S&P 500 20-day forward return.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) against a null model using only one of the two proxies.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 1% for three consecutive months, the S&P 500 exhibits positive 20-day forward returns as expectations of rate stability boost equity valuations.
regime_hint: near-zero or negative policy rate environment
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of such periods, or FEDFUNDS rises >0.25% in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in UNRATE unemployment coincides with a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate slower hiring.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls by >0.2 percentage points in a month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are non-negative in >70% of UNRATE down moves of similar magnitude.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in both INDPRO and RSAFS supply indicators produce a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return through risk aversion.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >50% of such dual contraction months.

mechanism_narrative: A regime shift to monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) predicts negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns as investors anticipate higher borrowing costs.
candidate_trigger: regime: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% and remains above for 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-negative in >60% of such regimes over the last 5 years.
